description:
The Commander Fleet Readiness Centers (COMFRC) Procurement Group, Patuxent River, MD 20670 hereby gives notice of their intent to award a purchase order to Clarity Communications Group LLC.  DBA Segra; 1 Lumos PLZ Suite 203 Waynesboro, VA 22980 (Cage Code: 4FVL7) on a sole source basis in accordance with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 6.103-1(b), only one source reasonably available and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements.

The Fleet Readiness Center East (FRCE) has a requirement for connection and maintenance that will support four (4) existing strands of single mode dark fiber. This connection is important for the off-site location to have reliable service. 

Segra is the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the dark fiber infrastructure and retains all rights required to provide the necessary connection and maintenance.

THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES. However, all responsible sources may submit a capability statement, which, if received within five (5) calendar days after the date of the publication of this synopsis, will be considered.   Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement.  A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based upon responses received as a result of this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government.

Point of contact for this requirement is Jessica Franceschini at  jessica.d.franceschini.civ@us.navy.mil
